name: Manhattan Community Award Program (MCAP) (2007-2017)
description:
This dataset lists awards made through the Manhattan Community Award Program (MCAP) for fiscal years 2007 through 2017. Each row records a single allocation and includes the fiscal year, the sponsoring city agency, the recipient organization, the project title, and the dollar amount awarded. Agencies include DFTA, DOE, DOH, DPR, and DOHMH, and organizations range from block associations and community development corporations to senior service providers. Allocations vary widely, from under $2,000 to $940,000, with a typical award of a few thousand dollars.

The data can be used to track how community grant funding changed over the decade, compare award activity across agencies and organizations, see what kinds of projects received support, and analyze the size and distribution of individual allocations. It is useful for budget transparency, funding trend analysis, and research on discretionary or community-level public spending in Manhattan.
